scientific_integrity: Theorems argued by explicit normal-domain-of-attraction and inverse-renewal proof, plus pre-existing variance comparison. Finite checker tests are support, not a substitute for infinite-time proof.
scientific_limitations: Only independent Rayleigh wall emissions, a fresh-renewal initial condition and completed two-leg cycle energy rewards; weak rather than strong/finite-time normal approximation. Previous work already establishes the raw heat-current variance, which is not claimed as new; the Gaussian weak limit and the calibration mismatch are the assessed contribution. Historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Gaussian central fluctuations without Gaussian variance calibration for a thermal-wall tracer
